Two parallel 104-element arrays are sentinel-filled with -1: the node-ID array at this+0x3C74 and the slot dword array at this+0x3E18
UtilityFunction_a800 is invoked with the object field read from this+0x3FB8
When argument a2 is non-zero, the per-slot struct initialization runs
StructFieldZeroInitWithDefaults zero-initializes each remaining slot struct (140-byte stride) starting from the first unused entry (dword index 35*count+229) for (104-count) entries
Slot validation only runs when the session phase at this+0x3FC4 is not 3
Iterate over the 104 slot entries at this+0x1D4
Only entries that are not the -1 sentinel are validated against the node-ID array
Linear search of the current slot count entries in the node-ID array at this+0x3C74 for the slot entry's value
When the value is not found (or the count is empty) and the session type dword_7C569C is not 5, the stale-slot debug report is emitted

The stale slot entry at this+0x1D4 is reset to -1
Return the last validation result v5 (0 unless a stale-entry report path ran)
